topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
Lands #1368 from an internal branch. That PR comes from an organization fork, which cannot grant maintainer edit access and does not get CI secrets, so it cannot be finished in place. The first commit here is @ihooni's original commit unchanged; the second is the maintainer steps from docs/ops.md.

## Chain

GIWA Sepolia Testnet, chain ID 91342, OP Enterprise self-managed. See #1368 for the operator's full write-up. Summary of what was verified on chain and on explorers:

- Deployment tx [`0xf4b05ce5…1240`](https://eth-sepolia.blockscout.com/tx/0xf4b05ce502142616c0d7d533348ca18d77fc832f090c870ecf347a889a921240) in block 8830872 via OPCM `0xEbBAD33C…` created the four proxies in `[addresses]`.
- `ProxyAdminOwner` `0x0B266965c88C78f17e1F9f59784249bf8Da1CB9E` is a 2-of-2 Safe v1.3.0 and owns `ProxyAdmin` `0x6AdB900DC56F7028D5E7943638897C8103cf0da5`, so `governed_by_optimism = false`.
- Custom `SuperchainConfig` `0xEF3a8c9Ec7873C3ACEE4e6153fb66072cdE9032d` (deployed with `configType = "custom"`).
- Every field in the generated `giwa.toml` matches the operator's published [rollup config](https://github.com/giwa-io/node/blob/main/genesis/consensus/sepolia-rollup.json): genesis L1/L2 hashes and numbers, `l2_time`, system config, block/sequencer params, all hardfork times, batch inbox, portal and system config addresses, EIP-1559 params.
- `keep_karst_upgrade_gas` stays unset (false): the Karst activation block carried a one-off gas limit and the next block returned to 60M.

## Short name

Staged as `giwasepolia` to match ethereum-lists (required by `check-chainlist`, which passed before the rename), then renamed to `giwa` at the operator's request so the identifier is `sepolia/giwa` and the network name `giwa-sepolia`. Same pattern as `arena-z-testnet` → `arena-z` in #1092.

## Unrelated hunks in addresses.json

Codegen for the sepolia superchain also picked up role drift on Unichain Sepolia (1301): `BatchSubmitter`, `Proposer`, `UnsafeBlockSigner`. These hunks are byte-identical to #1369. They cannot be dropped from this PR because `check-codegen` regenerates the whole superchain and fails on any drift. Whichever PR lands first, the other merges cleanly.

## Checks run locally

- `just check-chainlist` (pre-rename: passed; post-rename: no staged config, as CI will see it)
- `just sync-staging --l1-rpc-urls=$SEPOLIA_RPC_URL`
- `just codegen $SEPOLIA_RPC_URL sepolia`
- `just check-genesis-integrity` (sepolia/giwa OK)
- `just apply-hardforks` (no diff)
- `check_depsets` (55 chains processed)
- `sync_staging` re-run on the empty staging dir (no diff)

topPRs.author: ihooni
topPRs.body:
# Adding a New Chain

This PR adds GIWA Sepolia Testnet (chain ID 91342) to the registry.

## About the chain

- Deployed with op-deployer (`op-contracts/v3.0.0`) in July 2025. Deployment tx: [`0xf4b05ce5…1240`](https://eth-sepolia.blockscout.com/tx/0xf4b05ce502142616c0d7d533348ca18d77fc832f090c870ecf347a889a921240)
- Not part of the OP Sepolia superchain. It was deployed with `configType = "custom"`, so it has its own `SuperchainConfig` (`0xEF3a8c9Ec7873C3ACEE4e6153fb66072cdE9032d`) and `ProtocolVersions` (`0x8B44f83a06049441b4dE3EEAb8ca2305A5C2360a`), and an OPCM instance bound to them (`0xebbad33c10e83a5c2473be3f8b9ba8a9fc584b8c`). The implementations are the standard v3.0.0 set.
- Upgraded since then through Upgrade 19 ([execution record](https://github.com/giwa-io/chain-operations/tree/main/sepolia/2026-07-06-upgrade-19)). The L1 implementations now match the standard `op-contracts/v7.0.0` Sepolia set.
- `ProxyAdminOwner` is a 2-of-2 Safe (`0x0B266965c88C78f17e1F9f59784249bf8Da1CB9E`), so `governed_by_optimism = false`. Fault proofs are permissioned (respected game type 1).
- Genesis and rollup config are also published at https://github.com/giwa-io/node/tree/main/genesis.

## How the files were generated

- Ran `just create-config` with our op-deployer `state.json`. Our OPCM isn't listed in `standard-versions-sepolia.toml`, so the contracts version can't be auto-detected. We set `L1_CONTRACTS_VERSION=tag://op-contracts/v3.0.0`, the locator from our intent.
- Filled in the fields from step 4 of docs/ops.md. Also added `isthmus_time`, `jovian_time` and `karst_time`, which were activated after deployment. They match our published rollup config.
- `state.json` isn't included, following guidance on earlier chain PRs. We can share it if you'd like to run the staging report.
- Checked locally: the genesis hash computed from the `.json.zst` matches `genesis.l2.hash`, and `just check-chainlist` passes.

## Requests / notes

- **Short name:** staged as `giwasepolia` to match ethereum-lists, which `check-chainlist` requires. Could the final config be `sepolia/giwa.toml`, so the network name becomes `giwa-sepolia`? This is similar to `arena-z-testnet` → `arena-z` in #1092.
- **Hardforks:** `superchain_time` is intentionally unset because our activation times differ from the Sepolia superchain schedule.
- **`keep_karst_upgrade_gas`:** should stay `false`. The Karst activation block (L2 #29972484) has a gas limit of 115,370,657, and the next block is back at 60,000,000.
- **Maintainer access:** this PR comes from an organization fork, which doesn't support "Allow edits from maintainers". We're happy to add maintainers as collaborators on `giwa-io/superchain-registry`. Just let us know who.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have run `just codegen $SEPOLIA_RPC_URL,$MAINNET_RPC_URL` to ensure that all auto-generated files are updated
  - Not run, per [docs/ops.md](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/blob/main/docs/ops.md#6-await-review).
- [ ] I have checked `Allow edits from maintainers` on this PR.
  - Not available for organization forks (see above).
